name: recordstuff-website
description: Static official website for RecordStuff: product, download and help pages.

scripts.build: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/manifest.mts verify --online && env -u SITE_MANIFEST_OFFLINE SITE_MANIFEST_VERIFIED=1 astro build
scripts.check: astro check && pnpm build && node scripts/check-release.mts && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/check-links.mts
